policy.description: Exact subset search using explicit policy points; scores are neither probabilities nor revenue or attendance forecasts.

policy.missingFeeRule: An act with no valid buyer-entered fee cannot enter a bookable slate. Money is rounded to cents.
policy.missingFitRule: Unsupported or absent fit contributes zero affinity points and increases the evidence penalty. Any selected act without fit evidence makes the result provisional.
policy.genreRule: Genres are buyer-entered planning categories. Unknown genres earn no breadth reward and cannot establish a genre concentration.
policy.riskRule: Risk tolerance only scales the penalty for incomplete evidence; it does not estimate commercial risk.
policy.aggregation: Fit, momentum, local support and discovery are averages across slots. Genre breadth and repeated-genre pairs are normalized across the slate.
policy.tieBreak: Higher unrounded score, then lower total fee, then lexicographic candidate IDs.
